behavior: RobinhoodTrader never authenticates to Robinhood itself; it injects the auth-service box token into robin_stocks' session (set_login_state + Authorization header).
A box-auth failure at construction is logged and swallowed; the broker is created unauthenticated and every later call retries via _ensure_auth.
proof: Construct with AUTH_SERVICE_URL unset; expect log '[rh] Box auth failed at init' and authenticated=False, no raise.

behavior: Every account/order call runs _ensure_auth, which raises RuntimeError('not authenticated — box token unavailable') when the box can't vend a token.
proof: Call positions() with box unreachable; expect RuntimeError, not an empty list.

behavior: in_device_challenge_mode is hard-coded False; device approval/OTP state only surfaces through the box (/auth/status), not the broker.
account() treats an empty profile or portfolio response as a dead token: it force-refreshes the box token once and retries.
proof: Stub load_account_profile -> {} first call; expect log 'forcing re-auth' and one get_box_token(force=True).

behavior: open_orders() avoids robin_stocks get_all_open_stock_orders (crashes on orders missing 'cancel') and filters get_all_stock_orders to queued/unconfirmed/confirmed/partially_filled itself.
proof: Feed an order dict without 'cancel'; expect it listed, no KeyError.

behavior: submit_order always sends timeInForce=gtc, uses limit only when order_type=limit AND limit_price is set (else market), and returns None on any exception or a response without id.
proof: Submit limit with limit_price=None; expect a MARKET order. Submit with rh.orders.order raising; expect None and an error log.

behavior: Stock orders go straight to Robinhood with the vended token, so the auth-service trailing-stop-only guardrails never see them. The only gate is DRY_RUN in /api/trade, and a request body dry_run:false overrides the service default.
proof: With DRY_RUN=true service config, POST /api/trade {dry_run:false, broker:robinhood}; observe rh.orders.order called (stub it).
notes: Guardrail mandate ('trailing stops are the only sanctioned mutation') holds at the box only. Superseded in severity by rh-api-trade-unauthenticated.

behavior: RobinhoodTrader.cancel_order calls rh.orders.cancel_stock_order directly with no dry_run and no already-gone handling (unlike AuthServiceClient.cancel_order).
proof: Cancel a filled order id; observe whatever robin_stocks returns/raises.

behavior: Option purchase_price = RH lot average_price / 100; option_type comes from the instrument (call/put) and position_type from the position (long/short). If the instrument lookup fails it falls back to position_type (known-broken legacy path).
proof: Compare purchase_price to RH app avg cost for one lot, e.g. Nov-20 230C.

behavior: If option market data fails, mark_price silently equals purchase_price (unrealized P&L reads 0) and greeks stay None; underlying falls back to latest stock price.
proof: Stub get_option_market_data to raise; expect mark_price == purchase_price, unrealized_pl == 0.

behavior: realized_pnl replays the full stock+crypto fill history (any cumulative_quantity>0 counts, regardless of terminal state) and filters only realize events to the window.

Every /api/trade/* route (order, buy, sell, cancel, cancel-all) has no auth check. Only robinhood_proxy routes check DASHBOARD_REQUEST_TOKEN. The routes are mounted on the public allocation-engine-api web service. Order routes can be armed per request with dry_run:false; cancel and cancel-all have no dry_run at all and go straight to the broker (RH cancel_all_stock_orders, IBKR reqGlobalCancel).
proof: Local: no-header POST {dry_run:false} -> 201 submitted, broker.submit_order called. Prod: GET on each route -> 405, so the routes are deployed. A prod POST was deliberately not sent.
verified_by: local harness run + curl GET 405 on prod
notes: Fix open: PR #149 (token gate + DRY_RUN ceiling). Flip to status=fixed once merged and deployed.
